title: Percentile Stream Tiler & Regression Watchdog for per-route/model/region
creator: Maya Chen
description: Implement a streaming percentile tiler and a low-noise regression watchdog that produces p95/p99 latency signals at route x model x region granularity, correlated with tokens/sec and synthetic load cohorts.
background: Current percentile telemetry aggregates at coarse levels and mixes routes with heterogeneous payloads, obscuring regressions that only appear for specific model variants or regions. Existing dashboards often require manual slicing and offline replay to pinpoint root cause. This initiative creates continuously updated per-slice percentile tiles that feed an automated regression detector and a set of lightweight dashboards for on-call and SRE consumers.
technical_design:
1) Stream tile emitter: extend the percentile-telemetry pipeline to emit tiled quantile sketches keyed by {route, model_version, region, cohort}. Use memory-bounded sketches (e.g., KLL) with exponential decay windows (1m/5m/1h) to preserve tail fidelity.
2) Regression watchdog: sliding-baseline comparator that computes drift scores using robust statistics (median-of-deltas + bootstraped CI) and outputs alerts when p95 or p99 shifts exceed configurable thresholds for >N continuous windows.
3) Tokens/sec correlation: enrich each tile with tokens_in, tokens_out, requests, and batching histograms so regressions can be triaged as throughput-driven or model-change-driven.
4) Dashboard layer: precompute rollups for a route/model/region matrix and surface sparklines, heatmap tiles, and an interactive slice selector that can pivot on labels (customer tier, request size, function-calls-on/off).
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Emit tiles for top 50 busiest routes across two regions (us-west-2, eu-west-1) and three model families. Phase 2: Wire regression watchdog and send findings to trial on-call Slack channel + create Canary alerts. Phase 3: Full rollout across all routes with per-customer opt-out and retention tuning.
dashboards: quantile-tiles-overview: heatmap of p95/p99 by route x model x region
route-inspector: time-series p95/p99 with tokens/sec overlay and request size histogram
regression-watchdog-board: active alerts, drift-score timeline, bootstrap CIs
oncall-snapshot: per-incident diagnostic panel linking to last N traces and replay job
